title: Blood Memory Wake
description: Bridge Remembers Blood: Blood Memory Wake unfolds across collapsing rune-iron spans, swinging chains, lightning-carved lanes, and oath-stones bleeding rainwater, pushing the one active Asgardian Titan to convert endurance into decisive counterpressure.
lore: Blood Memory Wake advances the Storm-Oath Covenant arc: the Gate tries to harvest Asgardian vows, while Valhalla law insists courage must remain chosen responsibility.
terrain: collapsing rune-iron spans, swinging chains, lightning-carved lanes, and oath-stones bleeding rainwater

objectives.primary: Rescue marked allies while the bridge reshapes safe lanes.
optional: Keep your active Titan above 40% integrity
Trigger at least two Oathbound counterattacks

specialRules: Remembered Impact: every third turn, old oath scars reshape safe lanes through physical bridge collapse.
Oathbound: surviving damage strengthens the next committed strike.
victoryConditions: Rescue marked allies while the bridge reshapes safe lanes.

stars.one: Primary completed under severe integrity or turn pressure

activeTitanDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard one active Titan; nonstandard modes require explicit Creator approval.

tacticalProfile.rule: Recommended advantages only — any valid active Titan can attempt the mission.

activeTitanPolicy.rosterPurpose: Choose the best single Titan before launch; roster depth changes approach, not on-field body count.
